name: tool-websearch-gemini
title: Web search: your agent searches the web with Gemini and Google Search (needs an API key)
description: The `websearch` tool, for the agents that name it: Gemini answers grounded in Google Search, with its sources; the key the model never sees. An alternative to tool-websearch-brave.

environment.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environment.description: A Gemini API key, from aistudio.google.com/apikey (the free tier works). Optional: without it the app starts and each search fails saying so. Read through secrets; the model never sees it.
